backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, medical file storage, ML health risk predictions, and access control with authorization mixins for the healthcare backend.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four features related to removing custom Q&A functionality and improving assistant pattern matching with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, utilities, and configuration for the healthcare app with Design B theme system.
frontend/DEPLOY_NOTES.md: Deployment fix documentation explaining resolution of Node.js environment variable issues and duplicate provider wiring that caused frontend build failures.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system variables for both default and dark themes with Design B warm green palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with all routes and composing providers (QueryClient, InternetIdentity, Theme, DesignB) with DesignBAppShell layout.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialStore.ts: LocalStorage-based demo account management implementing account creation, credential verification, and phone number uniqueness enforcement with simple password hashing.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialTypes.ts: TypeScript type definitions for demo account structure and authentication result types used in sign-in/sign-up flows.
frontend/src/auth/session.ts: Manages local authentication sessions (OTP, password, guest) in localStorage with 30-day expiration, providing save/load/clear/validate functions.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Command interpreter using fuzzy matching and pattern recognition to route user input to navigation, medical knowledge, report analysis, or help responses.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: React component rendering the assistant chat UI with speech recognition, text-to-speech, transcript display, confidence indicators, and medical content formatting.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Handles localStorage persistence and migration of assistant conversation transcripts with versioning and confidence level support.
TypeScript type definitions for assistant messages, states, command results, confidence levels, and report analysis context.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Main assistant widget component managing conversation state, command interpretation, report analysis flow, and integration with medical file uploads.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Custom: Empty file, likely placeholder for custom question-answer management functionality.
frontend/src/components/assistant/custom: Empty file, likely placeholder for custom QA storage functionality.
Empty file, likely placeholder for custom QA type definitions.
frontend/src/components/assistant/fuzzyQ: Empty file, likely placeholder for fuzzy matching logic for custom QA.
frontend/src/components/assistant/medica: Curated medical knowledge base with detailed information on blood pressure, diabetes, and other health topics including symptoms, precautions, and emergency guidance.
frontend/src/components/assistant/report: Provides deterministic, pattern-based analysis of medical report text, extracting key findings, interpretations, suggested actions, and red flags using regex patterns and keyword matching without AI/LLM.
Extracts plain text from file bytes for text-based formats (txt, csv, json, etc.), validating that decoded content is not binary garbage by checking for excessive control characters.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useAss: React hook managing assistant conversation transcript state with localStorage persistence, providing methods to add messages and clear history.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useSpe: React hook wrapping Web Speech API for voice recognition with retry logic, confidence scoring, interim results, and error handling for network/permission issues.
React hook for text-to-speech using Web Speech Synthesis API, managing speaking state and providing enable/disable toggle with cancellation support.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useTra: React hook managing auto-scroll behavior for transcript containers, detecting user scroll position and automatically scrolling to bottom when new messages arrive if user is near bottom.
frontend/src/designB/components/Dashboar: Reusable dashboard section header component displaying title, optional caption, and action slot with consistent styling.
Interactive dashboard tile component with icon, label, value, and caption, supporting multiple color accents, sizes, variants, hover effects, and optional close button.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBS: Simple surface container component with three variants (default, elevated, outlined) for consistent card-like UI elements.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBT: Typography components (PageTitle, SectionTitle, Caption, BodyText) providing consistent text styling across the Design B theme.
frontend/src/designB/components/ThemeSwi: Toggle switch component for switching between default and Design B themes using the design context.
frontend/src/designB/data/placeholders.t: Defines UserProfile interface and exports a mock user profile generated with a fixed seed for consistent demo data.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBAppSh: Main app shell component for Design B theme with sticky header showing logo/branding, conditional user display name, theme switcher, bottom navigation tabs, assistant widget, and footer with attribution.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBBotto: Fixed bottom navigation component with tabs for Home, Reports, and Profile routes, highlighting the active tab based on current location.
frontend/src/designB/storage/themePrefer: Utility functions to save and load theme preference ('default' or 'designB') to/from localStorage with error handling.
frontend/src/designB/theme.ts: Defines Design B theme constants (colors, fonts, spacing, radius) and functions to apply or remove the theme by setting a data attribute on the document root.
frontend/src/designB/themeContext.tsx: React context provider and hook for managing Design B theme state, persisting preference to localStorage and applying theme via data attribute.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthSession.ts: Hook for managing local authentication session state including OTP, password-based, and guest sign-in methods with session validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoOtp.ts: Hook providing demo OTP generation, verification with expiry/cooldown logic, and session management for phone-based authentication flows.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flows, and identity state with various status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useMedicalFiles.ts: Hook providing queries and mutations for medical file management including listing metadata, uploading files as ExternalBlob, deleting files, and downloading/retrieving file bytes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains query hooks for backend data fetching, including an example structure and a hook to fetch the current user's profile via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useRedirectIfAuthenti: Hook that redirects authenticated users (via Internet Identity or local session) from public pages to /home after initialization completes.
frontend/src/hooks/useRequireAuth.ts: Route guard hook that redirects unauthenticated users to /signin by checking both Internet Identity and local session state (OTP, password, guest).
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDisplayName.ts: Hook that resolves user display name with priority: saved profile name, local session fullName/phone, guest label, shortened principal for Internet Identity, or fallback to 'Guest'.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind imports, custom CSS variables for theming (light/dark modes), and Design B theme overrides using data attributes.
frontend/src/lib/flaker.ts: Deterministic fake data generator using seeded PRNG to create realistic demo user profiles including names, emails, phones, blood types, allergies, and emergency contacts.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function 'cn' that merges Tailwind CSS classes using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AppointmentDetails.ts: Empty file placeholder for appointment details page component.
frontend/src/pages/Chatbot.tsx: Medical chatbot page with assistant panel, command interpretation, report analysis workflow (file selection, text extraction, analysis), and transcript management.
frontend/src/pages/DoctorList.tsx: Empty file placeholder for doctor list page component.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboard.tsx: Protected dashboard page displaying health metrics (heart rate, sleep, steps, etc.) and quick action tiles for chatbot, reports, and other features with navigation.
frontend/src/pages/Locate.tsx: Empty file placeholder for locate page component.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundRedirect.tsx: Component that redirects 404/removed routes to /home using useEffect and TanStack Router navigation.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Profile page component that displays and allows editing of user personal information, medical details, and emergency contacts. Includes sign-out functionality and integrates with Internet Identity and local session management.
frontend/src/pages/Report.tsx: Medical reports management page that allows users to upload, download, and delete medical files. Displays a list of uploaded reports with file metadata and provides file size/date formatting utilities.
frontend/src/pages/SignIn.tsx: Sign-in page with three authentication methods: Internet Identity, OTP-based phone authentication, and password-based phone authentication. Includes multi-step OTP flow with resend functionality and guest access option.
frontend/src/pages/SignUp.tsx: Account creation page that collects full name, phone number, and password to create a new account. Initializes local profile with sign-up details and creates an authenticated session upon successful registration.
frontend/src/pages/Welcome.tsx: Landing page with hero image, logo, and feature highlights that provides options to sign in or continue as guest. Redirects authenticated users automatically.
frontend/src/profile/profileBackendMappe: Utility module for mapping between frontend ProfileDetails and backend UserProfile types. Includes converters for blood type enums and date/bigint timestamp transformations.
frontend/src/profile/profileLocalStore.t: Manages localStorage persistence for user profile data, keyed by phone number for authenticated sessions or a stable guest ID for guest sessions, with functions to load, save, clear, and initialize profiles from auth data.
frontend/src/profile/profileTypes.ts: Defines the ProfileDetails interface containing user health information (name, contact, blood type, allergies, emergency contact) and provides utility functions to create empty profiles and check if profile data exists.
frontend/src/profile/profileValidation.t: Validates ProfileDetails fields including required full name, optional email/phone format checks, and ensures emergency contact fields are all filled if any are provided, returning validation results with human-readable error messages.
frontend/src/profile/useProfileDetails.t: React hook that provides profile data and save functionality, handling both Internet Identity backend storage and local session localStorage, with React Query for caching and mutations.
Manages localStorage for medical file metadata with functions to load, save, and delete individual file metadata by ID; deprecated for listing purposes as backend is now the source of truth.
frontend/src/utils/frontendEnv.ts: Provides frontend environment configuration by reading Vite's import.meta.env, specifically for Internet Identity URL with fallback to production II URL.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup functions for managing parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, typography settings, container queries, animations, and extended theme properties for a healthcare application UI.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document for a health chatbot showing completed features to remove custom Q&A UI and improve pattern matching, with pending requests to expand medical knowledge base and enable general health question answering.
